Jamie - PM: Quick async check-in for launch week — content calendar + benchmark posts. What you shipped yesterday / blockers / today? Calling out PRs for review. @anya @mike @sofia
Anya M.: Yesterday: finalized 3 blog drafts (launch explainer, infra deep-dive, cost playbook). Uploaded assets to /drive/launch-assets. Blocker: need final brand image from Lucas for infra deep-dive. Today: add CTA + schedule posts.
Lucas (Design): On it, sending two hero options in 30m. FYI I changed the color on the cost playbook graphic to match the console UI. Ping me if you want alternate layout.
Mike R.: Yesterday: ran the embedding benchmark and draft benchmark post. Numbers look good — throughput improved ~18% after batching optimizations. PR: https://git.company/reports/bench/123 (draft). Blocker: need CF approval on the benchmark methodology paragraph. @olivia can you route to legal?
Olivia (Ops): Looping in legal slack channel. Also staging deploy scheduled for 11:30 PT — deploy-bot will post. If you need feature flags toggled for the demo, let me know.
deploy-bot: staging deploy started: commit a1b2c3 -> staging. Estimated 12m. CI: 12/12 checks passed.
Sofia L.: Yesterday: coordinated influencer outreach list, sent 12 invites. Blocker: no response template from PR — @anya can you share the speaking doc? Today: finalize launch email and coordinate with growth.
Anya M.: Shared speaking doc: https://drive/launch-assets/speaking-doc v2. Added talking points and metrics callouts. @sofia suggest using the short subject line we tested last month.
Jamie - PM: Small ask: can reviewers prioritize Mike's PR and Anya's blog by EOD? We have a hard cutoff for scheduling. Also need a screenshot of console perf graph from eng-releases — @mike can you grab one or ping eng-runtime?
Mike R.: I'll grab graph now. If eng-runtime isn't around, I can generate from the bench script. Posting screenshot in 10.
Lucas (Design): Posted hero options to drive and left comments. Also attached a lightweight GIF for the landing page: /drive/launch-assets/hero-anim.gif
Anya M.: Reviewers: @jamie @mike @sofia — blogs are in /drive/launch-assets/blogs. I've left editorial notes. Blocker resolved: got Lucas hero v2.
Jamie - PM: Thanks. Quick schedule summary: draft posts due today 3pm PT, bench post review by 5pm PT, final assets by 6pm PT. If anything slips, call it out here. :thumbsup:
Olivia (Ops): Deploy-bot update: staging deploy complete. Tagging QA to sanity-check content pages. QA channel: #support-qa
Sofia L.: Noted — I'll check the email renders after QA signoff. Also trying to get one last quote from partner.
deploy-bot: staging deploy finished: commit a1b2c3 -> staging. Duration 8m. All services healthy.
